## Setup

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(broom)
  library(survival)
})

signature_path <- "results/07_signature/signature_predictions.tsv"
score_path <- "data/healthy_lifestyle_scores.tsv"
disease_dir <- "data/diseases"
white_id_path <- "data/white_british_ids.txt"
covariate_path <- "data/covariates.tsv"
result_dir <- "results/08_signature_disease"
dir.create(result_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

case_frequency_cutoff <- 0.001
component_names <- c(
  "smoking_behavior_score",
  "alcohol_consumption_score",
  "physical_activity_score",
  "sleep_duration_score",
  "sedentary_behavior_score",
  "social_contact_score",
  "diet_score"
)
```

## Signature-component associations

```{r}
signature_df <- readr::read_tsv(signature_path, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(eid = as.character(IID))
score_df <- readr::read_tsv(score_path, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(eid = as.character(eid))

component_df <- signature_df |>
  inner_join(score_df, by = "eid") |>
  mutate(meta_signal_z = as.numeric(scale(meta_signal)))

signature_component_results <- map_dfr(component_names, function(component) {
  model_df <- component_df |>
    select(meta_signal_z, all_of(component)) |>
    drop_na()
  model_fit <- lm(
    reformulate(component, response = "meta_signal_z"),
    data = model_df
  )

  broom::tidy(model_fit, conf.int = TRUE) |>
    filter(term == component) |>
    transmute(
      component = component,
      estimate,
      std.error,
      statistic,
      p.value,
      conf.low,
      conf.high,
      n = nobs(model_fit)
    )
})

readr::write_csv(
  signature_component_results,
  file.path(result_dir, "signature_component_associations.csv")
)
```

## Incident-disease selection

```{r}
read_disease <- function(path) {
  disease_raw <- readr::read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  if (all(c("eid", "status", "years") %in% names(disease_raw))) {
    disease_raw |>
      transmute(
        eid = as.character(eid),
        status = as.numeric(status),
        years = as.numeric(years)
      )
  } else {
    disease_raw |>
      transmute(
        eid = as.character(eid),
        status = as.numeric(target_y),
        years = as.numeric(BL2Target_yrs)
      )
  }
}

white_ids <- readr::read_lines(white_id_path)
eligible_ids <- intersect(signature_df$eid, white_ids)
disease_files <- list.files(
  disease_dir,
  pattern = "\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

disease_summary <- map_dfr(disease_files, function(path) {
  disease_df <- read_disease(path) |>
    filter(eid %in% eligible_ids, years >= 0) |>
    drop_na(status, years)

  tibble(
    disease = tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(path)),
    path = path,
    total_n = nrow(disease_df),
    case_n = sum(disease_df$status == 1),
    control_n = sum(disease_df$status == 0),
    case_freq = case_n / total_n
  )
})

selected_diseases <- disease_summary |>
  filter(case_freq > case_frequency_cutoff)

readr::write_csv(
  selected_diseases,
  file.path(result_dir, "selected_incident_diseases.csv")
)
```

## Signature-disease Cox models

```{r}
covariate_df <- readr::read_tsv(covariate_path, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(eid = as.character(IID))
covariates <- intersect(
  c("Sex", "Age", "Fasting", "Month", "Center"),
  names(covariate_df)
)

signature_disease_results <- pmap_dfr(
  selected_diseases |> select(disease, path),
  function(disease, path) {
    model_df <- read_disease(path) |>
      filter(eid %in% eligible_ids, years >= 0) |>
      inner_join(covariate_df, by = "eid") |>
      inner_join(signature_df |> select(eid, meta_signal), by = "eid") |>
      drop_na(status, years, meta_signal, all_of(covariates)) |>
      mutate(
        meta_signal = as.numeric(scale(meta_signal)),
        across(any_of(c("Month", "Center")), as.factor)
      )

    model_fit <- coxph(
      reformulate(
        c(covariates, "meta_signal"),
        response = "survival::Surv(years, status)"
      ),
      data = model_df
    )

    broom::tidy(model_fit, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) |>
      filter(term == "meta_signal") |>
      transmute(
        disease = disease,
        HR = estimate,
        HR_lower = conf.low,
        HR_upper = conf.high,
        p.value,
        n = nobs(model_fit),
        events = sum(model_df$status == 1)
      )
  }
)

readr::write_tsv(
  signature_disease_results,
  file.path(result_dir, "signature_incident_disease.tsv")
)
```
